profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Grubhub
profile.summary:
I have enjoyed computers since the Apple IIe’s I tinkered with in grade school.  Programming is something I enjoy doing, and desire to get better at.  

Computer programming is more than writing code.  I find programming a creative process--an art-form.  Solutions are designed, crafted, and improved.

I started in Marketing and Communications, detailing and filing news stories and photos.  I am a shy person.  Marketing forced me to interact with people.  I did not realize how much it has helped me later in life. 

I have been on a helpdesk for 8 years, which included various projects dealing with scripting, software distribution, and server management.  I am currently Java developer working on back-end technologies.

positions.title: Software Engineer, JVM
positions.description:
Backend developer, using Java.  Been enjoying learning more Groovy and Scala.  Starting to dive more into Kotlin, Android development, and data science.  

Doing quite a bit of work on Spring microservices, using Docker, Cassandra, and a handful off AWS services (EC2, RDS, SQS, SNS, S3).

positions.title: Workstation Support Analyist
positions.description: Diagnose and repair computer hardware and software for 300+ end user and workstations.  Manage helpdesk software.  Manage WSUS server, Windows Deployment Services, Terminal Servers and Thin Clients, and Mac OS X Server within a Microsoft Active Directory Domain.  Provide long distance software support, sometimes via phone, for remote staff.  Plan and implement workstation projects and software deployments.  Train staff and interns.

positions.title: Visitor Services Lead
positions.description: Trained staff for ticketing and admissions software.  Developed department policies and procedures.  Developed group tours and sales.  Assisted in daily drawer and management operations.  Served as the main IT contact for the Visitor Services area, and as the contact for software vendor support.

positions.title: Receptionist
positions.description: Answered multiple incoming phone lines, redirecting to appropriate people and departments.  Coordinated package delivery.  Provided information about historic sites, as well as directions and places to see or things to do in Minneapolis and Saint Paul.

positions.title: Telecommunications Coordinator
positions.description: Answered incoming calls for calling card and long distance assistance. Coordinated voice conferencing.  Handled after hours service calls and security calls.
